name: XML
resume: Checked append, and endElement.SAX.xmlNode, append.XMLNode, Doctype, asXMLNode, and comment.SAX. Internal documents, XPath, HTML recovery, node construction, and URI resolution are checked. They call the system libxml2 through ctypes, the library the installed package links. SAX handlers, schemas, DTDs, catalogs, and the assignment methods are not translated. There is no crate.
